items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: We had a jukebox on at intermission that had Gene Krupa on the jukebox.

ctx.x: One time there was a -- Freddie was Freddie.
We had a jukebox on at intermission that had Gene Krupa on the jukebox. Freddie would listen to this record for 20

*Butler's pronunciation, but probably meaning Caughnawaga, the name of a Mohawk village near Auriesville, New York, near Canada. (see Swanton, Indian Tribes of North America, Smithsonian Bulletin of Amer. Ethnology, #145.
